title: Govern shadow AI copilots
subtitle: Inventory agents, route intake, review high risk cases and audit permissions.

steps.title: Inventory each AI solution
steps.evidence: Record each solution's data source, business owner, intended users and ability to trigger automated actions

steps.title: Route ideas through CoE intake
steps.evidence: A CoE intake process can route low-risk ideas quickly while requiring deeper reviews

steps.title: Review high impact agents
steps.evidence: requiring deeper reviews for agents handling regulated data or autonomous actions

steps.title: Audit permissions and access
steps.evidence: Apply least privilege to agent identities and audit existing SharePoint permissions
